ae.title: Dubai Police impound 1,903 electric bikes and scooters in one week, warn against dangerous stunts
ae.description: Dubai Police have impounded 1,903 electric scooters in just one week as part of intensified enforcement campaigns targeting dangerous riding practices, particularly reckless stunts performed by teenagers in public areas. Dubai Police warned against dangerous behaviour involving electric scooters, including riding on one wheel and performing stunts that put riders, pedestrians and visitors to tourist and recreational destinations at risk. Brigadier Juma Salem bin Suwaidan, Director of the General Department of Traffic at Dubai Police, said traffic patrols carried out intensive inspections over the past week, resulting in the impoundment of 1,903 electric scooters as part of ongoing efforts to prevent accidents and protect road users and visitors to public facilities. 1,194 bikes and scooters impounded at Kite Beach Brigadier bin Suwaidan revealed that intensified enforcement operations at Kite Beach in Jumeirah alone resulted in the seizure and impoundment of 1,194 electric bikes and scooters for violations in just seven days. He explained that several dangerous incidents involving teenagers had been observed in the area, with videos circulating online showing riders lifting their scooters onto one wheel and performing reckless stunts in areas frequented by the public. He stressed that such behaviour poses a serious threat to public safety and requires immediate intervention before it leads to accidents or serious injuries. Dangerous stunts can have tragic consequences Brigadier bin Suwaidan warned that riding an electric scooter on one wheel or performing stunts can cause riders to lose their balance and control, significantly increasing the risk of falls and collisions with pedestrians. He explained that the danger is particularly serious in crowded recreational areas, where families, children and beachgoers are frequently present. “These practices are not a form of entertainment or a demonstration of skill. They are reckless actions that could have tragic consequences,” he stressed. Increased patrols and strict enforcement Brigadier bin Suwaidan affirmed that Dubai Police will not tolerate dangerous riding practices and will continue deploying additional traffic patrols and enforcement teams across tourist destinations, recreational areas and locations popular with electric scooter users. Special attention will be given to areas where such violations have been repeatedly observed. He warned that anyone found performing dangerous stunts will face legal action, including the impoundment of their scooter, to protect public safety and deter behaviour that endangers others. Parents urged to monitor their children Brigadier bin Suwaidan called on parents to take an active role in supervising their children and ensuring they use electric scooters responsibly and in accordance with traffic regulations. He urged parents to educate young riders about the dangers of reckless behaviour and ensure they follow essential safety measures, including using designated riding areas, wearing protective equipment, particularly helmets, and staying away from crowded pedestrian and family areas. He also emphasised the importance of avoiding excessive speed, carrying passengers and performing any manoeuvres that could result in losing control of a scooter. Public urged not to share dangerous stunt videos Brigadier bin Suwaidan highlighted the importance of community cooperation in preventing such behaviour, urging the public not to share videos of dangerous scooter stunts on social media. He explained that circulating these videos could encourage other teenagers to imitate the behaviour in pursuit of online attention, popularity and views. He added that such incidents also create an impression that does not reflect Dubai’s reputation as a safe and responsible city. “These are isolated actions committed by a small number of individuals who disregard the rules. They do not reflect the behaviour of the wider community,” he noted. Report violations through Police Eye or 901 Dubai Police encouraged residents and visitors to report dangerous scooter riding through the Police Eye service on the Dubai Police app or by calling 901 through the We Are All Police programme. Brigadier bin Suwaidan stressed that reporting violations directly, rather than circulating videos online, enables police to respond promptly, prevent further incidents and strengthen community responsibility for everyone’s safety.

ae.title: Hamdan bin Mohammed chairs meeting of Higher Committee for Development and Citizens Affairs in Dubai
ae.description: Dubai: His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Defence of the UAE, Chairman of The Executive Council of Dubai and Chairman of the Higher Committee for Development and Citizens Affairs in Dubai, chaired a meeting of the committee. During the meeting, His Highness approved four projects to create economic opportunities for Emirati retirees, farmers and small business owners, strengthen family ties and preserve Dubai’s heritage. He also reviewed progress in family support, Emiratisation and neighbourhood development. Sheikh Hamdan said that the visionary leadership of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, places citizens’ wellbeing and empowerment at the heart of government work. His Highness noted that the government’s responsibility is to provide opportunities and services that support citizens at every stage of life. This includes helping young people establish stable families, creating opportunities for employment and enterprise, and enabling retirees to share their expertise. His Highness said the four projects draw on the experience of Dubai’s people, create new opportunities to earn a living and contribute to the community, and preserve Emirati heritage and identity. They will help small business owners and home-based producers succeed and ensure that Majalis remain places where generations come together to share knowledge and pass on values. Sheikh Hamdan said the measure of any project’s success is the difference it makes in people’s lives. He called on government entities to work together to ensure their initiatives reach citizens, meet their needs and give them better opportunities for the future. Government teams earn trust through their work and strengthen it by delivering results, he said. Their greatest achievement is to live up to the confidence the people of Dubai place in them. The four projects approved include ‘Al Hakeem’, a remote work platform that will give retired Emiratis a new source of income by connecting them with organisations and individuals seeking specialist advice. Presented at the meeting as the first platform of its kind worldwide, it will allow users to search by specialisation, view profiles and book online consultations. ‘Dubai Harvest’ will give Emirati farmers, small business owners and home-based producers space to grow and sell local produce. Covering around 21,000 square metres, the project will include 19 plots, glass units for agricultural and commercial use, a retail centre and a public square. Building on the first edition of Ghamran Camp, ‘Ahl Dubai Camps’ will bring families together at three camps focused on the desert, the sea and the Emirati home. Through hands-on activities, children will learn traditional skills and customs from their parents. The fourth approved project will upgrade the Umm Suqeim majlis and expand activities across Dubai’s fishermen’s majalis so fishermen can pass on their knowledge to younger generations. It also includes regular health screenings for fishermen in partnership with Dubai Health and work with the Dubai Culture and Arts Authority to recognise fishing-related occupations as traditional crafts. Family support and employment His Highness reviewed the Sheikha Hind bint Maktoum Family Programme, which recorded a beneficiary satisfaction rate of 99.5%. Its Dubai Weddings initiative has helped around 1,500 Emirati couples marry, and 99.6% of those couples remain married. By September 2026, 472 children had been born to participating families. His Highness also reviewed the work of the Emirati Human Resources Development Council in Dubai. At the end of 2025, 91,162 Emiratis worked in Dubai’s private sector. Of these, 32,087 were Dubai citizens, up more than 354% from 7,060 in 2021. The committee also reviewed completed projects in Al Barsha 2 and Al Khawaneej 2 under Dubai’s model neighbourhoods plan, which covers 37 areas. The next phase covers seven areas in 2026 and 2027. Improved pedestrian routes, additional parking, more trees and new community spaces will help residents reach everyday services more easily, supporting Dubai’s 20-minute city goal. The meeting was attended by His Excellency Omar Sultan Al Olama, Vice Chairman of the Higher Committee for Development and Citizens Affairs and Director General of the Crown Prince of Dubai’s Office, and His Excellency Mattar Al Tayer, Director General and Chairman of the Board of Executive Directors of the Roads and Transport Authority. Also present were His Excellency Lieutenant General Talal Belhoul Al Falasi, President of Dubai’s State Security Department, and His Excellency Lieutenant General Abdullah Khalifa Al Marri, Commander-in-Chief of Dubai Police. Other attendees included Her Excellency Hessa bint Essa Buhumaid, Director General of the Community Development Authority in Dubai, His Excellency Hamad Obaid Al Mansoori, Director General of the Dubai Digital Authority, and His Excellency Engineer Marwan bin Ghalita, Director General of Dubai Municipality. His Excellency Abdulla Ali bin Zayed Al Falasi, Director General of the Dubai Government Human Resources Department, and His Excellency Ali Al Mutawa, Secretary General of the Endowment and Minors’ Trust Foundation in Dubai (Awqaf Dubai), also attended.

ae.title: Embracing COP31 as a 'COP of Implementation': Side event explores pathways for global climate diplomacy and cooperation
ae.description: ANKARA, Turkey, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- A thematic side event titled "From Early Warning to Energy Action: Pathways for Global Climate Diplomacy and Cooperation" was held on the afternoon of November 13 local time at the Global Alliance of Universities on Climate during the 31st Conference of the Parties (COP31) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change. The 31st Conference of the Parties (COP31) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change. The event was jointly hosted by the United Nations Institute for Training and Research and the Public Meteorological Service Centre of the China Meteorological Administration (National Early Warning Information Release Center), with strategic support from China Energy News, the foreign affairs working committee of the China Energy Research Society (CERS), and the China Institute of Energy Economics Research. Representatives from Russia, China and various international organizations, including the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) and the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), attended the event. Participants held in-depth discussions on climate risk prevention, early warning systems, energy transition and international cooperation, exploring ways to effectively translate climate warnings into concrete energy actions. At the event, the Climate Leadership Impact (CLI) platform presented its first bilingual report in Chinese and English, titled "From Early Warning to Energy Action: 2026 Innovation Showcase on China's Corporate Actions and Collaborative Practices." The report highlights how measurable and replicable industrial practices can contribute to COP31's theme of a "COP of Implementation." Focusing on preventing climate disasters and enhancing climate resilience, it explores energy-led approaches to climate action, with the aim of bringing greater certainty and positive momentum to global climate governance. Joint efforts to translate early warnings into energy action The World Meteorological Organization's (WMO) State of the Global Climate Update 2026, released during the conference, shows that the global average surface temperature in the first nine months of 2026 was approximately 1.47 degrees above pre-industrial levels. An exceptionally strong El Niño event is expected to further intensify high temperatures and extreme weather, with impacts likely to continue into 2027. The number of countries with multi-hazard early warning systems has increased from 56 in 2015 to 136 in 2025. Meanwhile, the UN Environment Programme's Adaptation Gap Report 2026 estimates that developing countries will need approximately $305 billion annually in adaptation financing by 2035. Even if the target of tripling international public adaptation finance is achieved, it would cover only around 20 to 30 percent of the estimated needs. While early warning coverage is expanding, funding, institutional mechanisms and capacity have not kept pace. Sergey Kononuchenko, special representative of the Russian Foreign Ministry for climate issues and ambassador-at-large, said in his address that climate change is an urgent challenge facing humanity and that the priority now is to translate commitments into concrete action. He stressed the need to strengthen early warning systems through technological innovation, including artificial intelligence and satellite observation, to protect critical energy infrastructure; uphold multilateralism and ensure developing countries have equitable access to early warning technologies and capacity-building opportunities; and urge all parties, particularly developed countries, to honor their commitments on climate financing and technology transfer. He also recognized China's achievements in building the world's largest renewable energy system and carbon emissions trading market, expressing hope that COP31 would serve as a platform for practical action. "Early warning is not the end point, but the starting point for action," said Sun Zhengyun, vice chairman and secretary-general of the CERS. He noted that improvements in forecasting capabilities do not necessarily translate into stronger response capacities. To bridge this gap, Sun said, efforts should first be made to effectively connect climate early warnings with power grid dispatch, renewable energy generation forecasting, energy storage management and emergency response, ensuring that warning information is genuinely incorporated into energy system operations. Climate risk management should also be strengthened in energy planning and investment decisions to improve the resilience of projects from the outset. In addition, international cooperation should be deepened, with greater emphasis on capacity building in developing countries, enabling more regions to develop comprehensive capabilities to translate early warnings into action. Xie Rongbin, Party secretary, chairman and editor-in-chief of China Energy and Automobile Media Group Co Ltd, president of China Automotive News, and editor-in-chief of China Energy News, said the global energy transition is a systemic transformation requiring the coordinated management of climate risk early warnings, technological innovation, industrial collaboration, market mechanisms, security safeguards and equitable development. The key, Xie said, is to turn early warning capabilities into effective emergency responses. China is actively exploring ways to integrate meteorological warnings with energy dispatch, while using technology to strengthen the resilience of energy systems against extreme weather shocks. In July this year, China's installed solar power capacity surpassed that of coal-fired power, making solar the country's largest source of installed power capacity. Andrew Tupper, head of the Early Warning Services at the WMO, expressed agreement with this approach. He noted that conventional, general-purpose weather warnings are no longer sufficient to meet current needs. There is an urgent need to establish "impact-based early warning systems" that connect meteorological information with energy operations, enabling warnings to trigger timely and targeted protective measures for energy assets. Bridging meteorology and energy through cross-sector collaboration Sergey Kononuchenko, special representative of the Russian Foreign Ministry As a core member of the research team behind the report From Climate Early Warnings to Energy Action: 2026 Progress Report on Chinese Enterprises' Actions and Collaborative Practices, Dr. Wang Jingyu, assistant director of the national key laboratory of advanced electromagnetic technology at Huazhong University of Science and Technology and an associate research fellow, presented the CLI platform's first bilingual report in Chinese and English. Wang said the report features 16 practical case studies across six categories, covering renewable energy output forecasting, infrastructure protection, power grid dispatch and maintenance, energy security for key users, supply-demand adjustment, and emissions reduction and carbon sequestration. Ye Dong, a senior researcher at the Public Meteorological Service Centre of the China Meteorological Administration, introduced initiatives to harness AI for energy-related meteorological and climate services under the theme "From Accurate Forecasting to Enhanced Climate Resilience." Ye noted that meteorological conditions have a profound impact on the entire energy chain, from production and transmission to consumption. As global climate change intensifies, extreme weather poses increasingly prominent threats to energy systems. Meanwhile, non-disaster weather conditions with significant impacts, such as prolonged periods of weak winds and reduced sunshine, can also cause fluctuations in renewable energy output and disrupt the balance between electricity supply and demand. Specialized meteorological early warning services for the energy sector are therefore essential to ensuring energy security and strengthening the climate resilience of energy systems, Ye said. China is actively developing AI-based meteorological forecasting models tailored to energy-sector applications, drawing on domestically developed satellites and multi-source observation data. Ye stressed that AI is merely a technological tool, and that the key is to address real-world operational needs and translate accurate weather forecasts and warnings into concrete measures for protecting energy facilities, power dispatch and risk response. Practical applications on the power grid side have already established a complete chain from forecasting to response. State Grid Shaanxi Electric Power, drawing on standardized observation systems at power stations and the "Fuxi" meteorological foundation model, has achieved an accuracy rate of 95.2 percent in short-term power output forecasting. Its icing warnings now provide an additional 18 hours of lead time, while the initiative has cumulatively enabled an additional 65.05 million kilowatt-hours of renewable electricity generation. State Grid Zhoushan Power Supply Company in East China's Zhejiang Province has used a large AI model to coordinate preparations before disasters, emergency response during disasters and post-disaster repairs, reducing the average time needed to complete the fault-resolution process from eight hours to 4.7 hours. On the enterprise side, early warnings are being translated into economic returns and asset protection. China Resources Power Technology Institute has developed an integrated climate and energy storage management platform. Based on operational data from a wind power project equipped with energy storage in Central China's Hubei Province during the first half of this year, the platform is estimated to reduce renewable energy curtailment by 92.6 percent and increase overall economic benefits by more than 10 million yuan. Trina Solar has integrated module protection, grid-forming energy storage, and intelligent operation and maintenance. Estimates based on a 100-megawatt solar project in Texas, the US, indicate that the approach could reduce average annual asset losses by 94 percent, demonstrating the potential for similar solutions to be replicated in overseas regions facing high climate risks. Policy support is also creating an institutional framework for closer coordination between meteorology and the energy sector. In January this year, the China Meteorological Administration and the National Energy Administration jointly issued guidelines on developing an energy meteorological service system, setting out 20 tasks and aiming to establish an integrated energy meteorological service system covering all energy-sector scenarios by 2027. Tian Yuyang, assistant director of the foreign affairs working committee of the CERS, said the CLI platform would continue to advance its work across four areas: risk governance and financial support, AI-enabled forecasting and decision-making, coordinated clean energy dispatch, and interdisciplinary talent development. The goal is to translate research findings into operational applications and turn pilot experience into industry standards. China Energy and Automobile Media Group Co Ltd Under the theme "How can meteorological warnings be effectively translated into action within energy systems?" three representatives of international organizations – Tupper, Avishek Malla, head of renewable energy at the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD), and Binu Parthan, deputy director of country engagement and partnerships at IRENA – joined enterprise representatives, including Wu Xiao, vice president of Trina Solar and head of the group's ESG management and risk control, and Han Shutong, general manager of LONGi Green Energy Technology's UK representative office, for an in-depth discussion. The session was moderated by He Chaoxin, chief youth officer of the Global Alliance of Universities on Climate. Tupper pointed out that the bottleneck in cross-sector collaboration lies not in information sharing itself, but in whether energy departments genuinely rely on meteorological warnings when making dispatch decisions. Without trust built through long-term cooperation, warnings may remain merely reference information rather than becoming a basis for decision-making. The WMO is now incorporating this model of trust-based collaboration into its global early warning framework, promoting a shift from basic cooperation between meteorological and energy departments toward substantive operational coordination, Tupper said. Malla presented practical achievements in mountainous areas of South Asia. ICIMOD has established a multi-tiered early warning system that includes high-resolution forecasts up to 54 hours ahead, flood forecasts 10 to 15 days in advance and glacial lake outburst monitoring. Information is shared with government departments and local communities, while text messages and alerts are used to deliver warnings directly to the public. The center is also incorporating climate data into sensitivity analysis models used by hydropower investors and commercial banks, opening up new channels for integrating climate information into risk assessments of energy infrastructure. Parthan focused on the implementation stage after warnings are issued. Taking heatwaves as an example, he noted that high temperatures both reduce the transmission capacity of power lines and drive up electricity demand for cooling. However, such warning information has not yet been effectively incorporated into the operational planning of utility companies. He proposed bringing together multiple stakeholders, including power grid planners, government departments, system operators and financial institutions, to establish cross-sector mechanisms for short-term decision-making. This would enable early warning information to directly inform real-time energy system dispatch and investment decisions. Participants agreed that the main bottleneck in translating early warnings into action is shifting from meteorological technology to the operational rules of energy systems. The CLI platform's first progress report is a response to this challenge. By turning the practical experience of Chinese enterprises in dispatch response, resilience upgrades and cross-border cooperation into measurable and replicable industry references, the report aims to help transform COP31's theme of a "COP of Implementation" from a conference slogan into concrete action within energy systems. During the conference, China's approaches also offered developing countries new options for addressing gaps in their climate response capabilities. On November 11, China's AI-powered meteorological early warning solution, the "Mazu" all-in-one system, was unveiled to a global audience at a high-level forum on South-South cooperation on climate change. As of October 2026, the system had been deployed in eight countries, including Pakistan, Ethiopia and Sri Lanka, and was undergoing cloud-based trials in more than 50 countries. On November 12, He Yang, deputy head of the National Energy Administration, said at a high-level event on the Global Grid Accelerator initiative that China was willing to support countries in building power grids that ensure energy security and prosperity through a model of "shared provision."

sa.title: أمريكا.. تحقيق مع إنفيديا بشأن وصول رقائقها الإلكترونية إلى الصين
sa.description: أعلنت ولاية كاليفورنيا الخميس، أنها تجري تحقيقا في ما إذا كانت شركة إنفيديا قد ضللت الجمهور والمستثمرين بشأن وصول رقائقها الإلكترونية إلى الصين، رغم وجود قيود فدرالية على تصديرها. وقال المدعي العام للولاية، روب بونتا، في بيان "إن تصرفات شركة إنفيديا ورئيسها التنفيذي السابق تثير الشكوك بشكل واضح، بما في ذلك احتمال قيام الشركة بتضليل المستثمرين". استقالة جنسن هوانغ وكان مؤسس إنفيديا ورئيسها التنفيذي، جنسن هوانغ، قد استقال الأسبوع الماضي في أعقاب تقارير زعمت تورطه في علاقات، إحداها مع امرأة تدعى أليس هوانغ ويشتبه بكونها جاسوسة صينية. وأليس هوانغ التي لا تربطها صلة قرابة بمؤسس إنفيديا، هي المديرة السابقة لشركة الحوسبة السحابية "ميغاسبيد" التي تتخذ من سنغافورة مقرا، وكانت قد خضعت لتحقيقات من قبل السلطات المحلية في عام 2025 بشأن انتهاكات محتملة لقواعد الرقابة على الصادرات. ووافق جنسن هوانغ على المثول أمام الكونغرس في جلسة استجواب مغلقة في الأول من ديسمبر، لمناقشة قضايا تتعلق بالأمن القومي. الرقائق الإلكترونية وعلى الرغم من أن الولايات لا تملك سلطة مباشرة على قوانين التصدير الفدرالية، إلا أنه يحق لها مقاضاة الشركات بموجب القوانين المحلية. وأوضح بونتا أن كاليفورنيا أصدرت مذكرة استدعاء بحق إنفيديا للتحقيق في ما إذا كان رئيسها التنفيذي السابق أو الشركة قد "ضللوا المستثمرين والجمهور بشأن هذه المخاطر، ما يعد مخالفا للقانون". وأضاف بونتا: "تواجه إنفيديا وضعا معقدا يتجاوز الحدود الوطنية، لكن المبدأ الأساسي في قوانين الأوراق المالية للشركات واضح تماما: لا يجوز للشركات تضليل مستثمريها". القيمة السوقية لشركة إنفيديا وانخفضت القيمة السوقية لشركة إنفيديا بأكثر من تريليون دولار خلال أسبوعين. كما تراجع سعر سهم الشركة بأكثر من 3% الخميس مواصلا هبوطه، رغم أن إيرادات الشركة الإجمالية للربع الثالث تجاوزت توقعات المستثمرين.

sa.title: تدشين مشروع لتوفير المياه للنازحين في المدينة السكنية بقرية بني فايد بحجة
sa.description: دشن مركز الملك سلمان للإغاثة والأعمال الإنسانية أمس مشروعًا لتوفير المياه المستدامة للنازحين في المدينة السكنية بقرية بني فايد بمديرية ميدي في محافظة حجة. وتضمن المشروع حفر بئر ارتوازية بعمق 70 مترًا، وإنشاء خزان برجي إسمنتي بسعة 40 ألف لتر، إضافة إلى إنشاء محطة تحلية بطاقة إنتاجية تبلغ 4,000 لتر في الساعة، وتوفير 4 خزانات بلاستيكية، ومنظومتين للطاقة الشمسية. فضلًا عن تنفيذ شبكة متكاملة لإسالة المياه، ليستفيد من المشروع 232 أسرة نازحة في المجمع السكني والمناطق المجاورة لقرية بني فايد. مصدر آمن لمياه الشرب وأكد محافظ حجة اللواء عبدالكريم السنيني أهمية المشروع في توفير مصدر آمن ومستدام لمياه الشرب، والإسهام في تلبية الاحتياجات الأساسية للأسر النازحة، وتحسين ظروفها الصحية والمعيشية، مثمنًا الدعم الإنساني الذي تقدمه المملكة العربية السعودية للشعب اليمني عبر مركز الملك سلمان للإغاثة. ويأتي ذلك امتدادًا للجهود الإغاثية والإنسانية والتنموية التي تقدمها المملكة العربية السعودية عبر مركز الملك سلمان للإغاثة، لمساعدة الشعب اليمني الشقيق، وتعزيز الأمن المائي وتحسين الظروف المعيشية للأسر النازحة والمجتمعات الأشد احتياجًا.

iq.title: اليوم.. مواجهتان آسيويتان لمنتخبي العراق للناشئين والكرة الشاطئية
iq.description: شفق نيوز- بغداد يخوض منتخبا العراق للناشئينوكرة القدم الشاطئية، يوم الجمعة، مواجهتين مهمتين ضمن المنافسات الآسيوية، إذيلتقي منتخب الناشئين نظيره التايلاندي عند الساعة 3:00 عصراً بتوقيت بغداد، علىالملعب الوطني التايلاندي، ضمن الجولة الخامسة والأخيرة من تصفيات كأس آسيا تحت 17عاماً. وفي مواجهة أخرى، يلتقيالمنتخب العراقي لكرة القدم الشاطئية نظيره الياباني عند الساعة 1:00 ظهراً بتوقيتبغداد، ضمن منافسات نهائيات كأس آسيا، في مباراة يسعى من خلالها المنتخب العراقيإلى تحقيق نتيجة إيجابية ومواصلة مشواره في البطولة. وتكتسب مواجهة منتخبالناشئين أهمية خاصة، كونها المحطة الختامية لمباريات المجموعة الثانية، التي تضم،إلى جانب العراق وتايلاند، منتخبات هونغ كونغ والصين تايبيه والمالديف. ويتطلع المنتخب العراقيإلى إنهاء مشواره بنتيجة إيجابية والمنافسة على بطاقة التأهل إلى نهائيات كأس آسياتحت 17 عاماً 2027، المقرر إقامتها في أوزبكستان خلال شهر نيسان/أبريل المقبل، إذيتأهل متصدر كل مجموعة من المجموعات السبع إلى النهائيات. أما منتخب الكرةالشاطئية، فيخوض مواجهته الثانية ضمن المجموعة الأولى، بعد افتتاح مشاركته بمواجهةالمنتخب التايلاندي المضيف يوم 18 تشرين الثاني/نوفمبر، على أن يختتم مبارياته فيدور المجموعات بملاقاة البحرين يوم 22 من الشهر ذاته. ويتطلع المنتخب العراقيإلى حصد نتيجة إيجابية أمام اليابان لتعزيز حظوظه في المنافسة على إحدى بطاقاتالتأهل إلى الدور ربع النهائي، إذ تتأهل الفرق صاحبة المركزين الأول والثاني فيالمجموعات الثلاث، إلى جانب أفضل منتخبين يحتلان المركز الثالث.

sd.title: موجة نزوح جديدة تجبر (1409) أسر على الفرار مع اشتداد القتال في النيل الأزرق
sd.description: الدمازين 19 نوفمبر 2026 – تشهد مناطق واسعة في إقليم النيل الأزرق تزايداً في موجات النزوح السكاني نحو جنوب الإقليم، مدفوعة بتصاعد العمليات العسكرية وانعدام الأمن. ويتزامن ذلك مع تحذيرات من انهيار شبه كامل للأوضاع الإنسانية، وشح حاد في الغذاء والمأوى والخدمات الأساسية، وتسجيل تقارير أممية ومنظمات لنزوح عشرات الآلاف من الفارين. وقال ناشطون في العمل الإنساني بالإقليم لـ”سودان تربيون”، إن حركة النزوح الحالية تشمل عدداً من المحليات والمناطق، أبرزها قيسان وود الماحي وباو. وأوضح الناشطون فرار أسر جديدة إلى مناطق الاستقبال في جنوب الإقليم، ليرتفع إجمالي الأسر النازحة في هذه المسارات المحددة إلى 1409 أسر. وأكد الناشطون وصول 600 أسرة من ود الماحي إلى منطقة المهل، وذلك علاوة على أعداد النازحين الموجودين في المنطقة منذ موجات سابقة. إضافة إلى نزوح نحو 500 أسرة من محافظة باو باتجاه مناطق بلنق وشيتيو وشيتالوا؛ بحثاً عن ملاذ أكثر أماناً. وكشف الناشطون استمرار النزوح من محور مدينة قيسان، ومغادرة نحو 309 أسر من «المدينة 12» التابعة لمحافظة قيسان متجهة نحو مناطق بكوري ويارا وبمبدي. وتأتي هذه التطورات في سياق أزمة أمنية وإنسانية متفاقمة يشهدها إقليم النيل الأزرق منذ أشهر، مع احتدام المواجهات العسكرية بين الجيش السوداني والقوات المتحالفة معه من جهة، وقوات الدعم السريع وحلفائها في المنطقة من جهة أخرى. The post موجة نزوح جديدة تجبر (1409) أسر على الفرار مع اشتداد القتال في النيل الأزرق appeared first on سودان تربيون.
